# Command reference

Every command of the running app, as `pn ctl <command>` or a control-channel request sends it (see [Control](../control.md)). `{a, b?}` lists the params, `?` marks optional ones.


## general

| command | |
|---|---|
| `ping` | Check that the control channel answers |

## calib

| command | |
|---|---|
| `calib.homography` | Homography from 4 or more point pairs (normalised DLT); {pairs: [[[x,y],[u,v]],...]} |
| `calib.project` | Pixels of world points through a calibrated camera (null behind it); {camera, points: [[x,y,z],...]} |
| `calib.solve` | Calibrate a projector from world and picture points; {pairs: [[[x,y,z],[u,v]],...], size: [w,h], initial?, options?} |

## chan

| command | |
|---|---|
| `chan.read` | Cook a chan node and read its channels (values now; {samples: true} for all); {path, output?, samples?} |

## comp

| command | |
|---|---|
| `comp.collapse` | Group side-by-side nodes into a new component, ports where wires cross; {paths, name?} |
| `comp.expand` | Dissolve a component, its nodes move up beside it; {path} |
| `comp.library` | Component files in the project's components/ and the user's library |
| `comp.load` | Add a component from a file or the library (by name); {file, path?} |
| `comp.remove` | Take a component file out of the library (into its removed/ folder); {name, place?: project \| library} |
| `comp.save` | Write a component to a file (default: the library, <name>.comp.ron); {path, file?} |

## cook

| command | |
|---|---|
| `cook.play` | Run or stop the show clock; {playing?} (default true) |
| `cook.stats` | Cook pass timings since the last reset: passes, slowest pass, longest gap, late frames, stalls; {reset?} |
| `cook.status` | Show clock, last cook pass, watched nodes, thumbnail policy |
| `cook.thumbnails` | Global thumbnail switch; {mode: always \| when_free \| never} |

## edit

| command | |
|---|---|
| `edit.begin` | Claim editing for Claude (needs 3 s without user edits); {label?} |
| `edit.end` | Give editing back to the user |
| `edit.status` | Who is editing |

## geo

| command | |
|---|---|
| `geo.info` | Cook a geo node and describe it: parts (id, name, triangles), bounds, counts; {path, output?} |

## gpu

| command | |
|---|---|
| `gpu.info` | GPU adapter, texture size limit, errors raised so far |

## history

| command | |
|---|---|
| `history.list` | Recent history entries; {limit?} |
| `history.redo` | Redo one history entry |
| `history.undo` | Undo one history entry |

## node

| command | |
|---|---|
| `node.batch` | Apply ops as one all-or-nothing batch; {ops: [{op, ...}], label?} |
| `node.bind` | Drive a param (or one component, /t.translate.0) with a channel; {param, from, channel?} |
| `node.connect` | Connect an output to an input; {from, output?, to, input?} |
| `node.copy` | Copy side-by-side nodes with everything inside them; returns the text; {paths} |
| `node.create` | Create a node; {path, kind, params?} |
| `node.cut` | Copy side-by-side nodes, then delete them (one undo step); {paths} |
| `node.delete` | Delete a node and everything inside it; {path} |
| `node.disconnect` | Clear an input; {to, input} |
| `node.info` | One node: params, connections, cook status; {path} |
| `node.kinds` | Node types with their params, inputs and outputs; {kind?} |
| `node.list` | Nodes under a path; {path?, recursive?} |
| `node.lock` | Lock (hold outputs) or unlock a node; {path, locked?} |
| `node.paste` | Paste the nodes copied last (or `text`) into a component or the root; {into?, text?} |
| `node.rename` | Rename a node; {path, name} |
| `node.set` | Set params, null resets to the default; {path, params: {name: value}} |
| `node.snapshot` | Cook a tex node (or a geo node: its picture) and write its output as PNG (8-bit sRGB); {path, output?, file?} |
| `node.unbind` | Back to the param's stored value; {param} |
| `node.watch` | Cook a node every frame (or stop); {path, watch?} |

## osc

| command | |
|---|---|
| `osc.config` | OSC settings for this run: {enabled?, max_packet?, rate?, burst?, pattern_rate?, max_addresses?} |
| `osc.learn` | Bind a param to the next OSC address that arrives with a number; {param, timeout?, wait?} or {cancel: true} |
| `osc.send` | Send one OSC message; {host?, port, address, args?: [numbers, strings, booleans]} |
| `osc.status` | OSC listeners (port, bound, packets, drops, sources), senders, recent messages, params set by address, learn |

## output

| command | |
|---|---|
| `output.list` | Connected displays (ids for out.projector's display), open output windows, projectors, pacing |

## project

| command | |
|---|---|
| `project.info` | Project directory, unsaved changes, file errors, who is editing |
| `project.save` | Write project.ron now, also over a file that failed to merge |
| `project.settings` | Project settings with their values and what they do; {set?: {name: value}}, null resets (one undo step) |

## render

| command | |
|---|---|
| `render.frame` | Move a tex.render camera (its own, or the view.camera wired in) so its geometry fills the picture, keeping the direction; {path} |

## res

| command | |
|---|---|
| `res.analyze` | What the projectors need of every node they show: size, needed, verdict, suggestion; waits up to 3 s for render nodes to measure (pending: those that did not) |
| `res.optimize` | Give the nodes the suggested sizes, one undoable entry; {paths?, dry_run?} (paths: only these) |
| `res.overlay` | Colour the mappers' and render nodes' pictures by resolution (green 1:1, red coarse, blue wasted); {on?} |

## script

| command | |
|---|---|
| `script.bench` | Measure a script call: GIL attach, request round trip, trivial and 200-channel calls; {runs?} |
| `script.info` | The script node's Python: where it was found (or why not), version, state, call times, timeouts |

## state

| command | |
|---|---|
| `state.config` | Snapshot timing (not stored, every start has the defaults); {interval?, restore_on_start?}. Whether node state is kept at all is the project setting persist_state |
| `state.discard` | Discard what feedback loops, caches and other nodes hold, now and in the state files (locked nodes keep theirs) |
| `state.info` | Persistent state: settings, the files in the project's state directory, the last save and restore, what a snapshot would keep now |
| `state.restore` | Give the nodes their saved state back (latest, else previous, or {file}); replaces what they hold |
| `state.save` | Take a state snapshot now and wait for the file; {timeout?} in seconds |

## system

| command | |
|---|---|
| `system.check` | Show-machine settings that can ruin a show (gaming overlay, notifications) |
| `system.fix` | Apply one check's fix; replies with what it replaced; {id} |
| `system.process` | This process: working set, private bytes, handles, threads; GPU memory through wgpu's allocator |
| `system.restore` | Write back what system.fix replaced; {previous} as system.fix returned it |

## table

| command | |
|---|---|
| `table.read` | Cook a table node and read its rows; {path, output?, rows?} (rows: at most, default 100) |

## text

| command | |
|---|---|
| `text.fonts` | Font families and their styles, for tex.text's font and style; {family?} |

## ui

| command | |
|---|---|
| `ui.arrange` | Lay out all nodes again by depth and frame them |
| `ui.click` | Click an element or a point; {id \| x, y, button?, double?, ctrl?, shift?, alt?} |
| `ui.drag` | Drag between elements or points; {from: {id \| x, y}, to: {id \| x, y}, button?, steps?} |
| `ui.elements` | Automation ids with rects in points; {prefix?} |
| `ui.enter` | Show the inside of a component in the editor, the top level without a path; {path?} |
| `ui.frame` | Fit all nodes into the editor |
| `ui.key` | Press a key (egui name: Delete, Tab, F, Z, Enter, ...); {key, ctrl?, shift?, alt?} |
| `ui.options` | The editor's options (right-click on empty space); {chan_bars?} |
| `ui.place` | Move nodes in the editor; {nodes: {path: [x, y]}} |
| `ui.screenshot` | PNG of the window; {file?} (default %TEMP%/penumbra/ui.png) |
| `ui.scroll` | Mouse wheel over an element or point; {id \| x, y, dy} |
| `ui.select` | Select nodes in the editor (it shows the component they sit in); {paths} |
| `ui.state` | Selection, viewer, pan and zoom, editing mode; {positions?} |
| `ui.type` | Type text into the focused field; {text} |
| `ui.view` | Pin the viewer to a node, or unpin without a path; {path?} |
